note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of Hamilton's official straight front render (40 mm case silhouette, listing; bracelet 20.26 mm measured against 20 mm lug width). Heights before the house depth scale (10.8 mm thick listing). House method: modelled polished case with lugs and crown-side flank (one body from the traced outline), two-step polished bezel, crown, applied faceted indices and numerals 12, 9, 6, hands and the five-column bracelet; the photo map serves only the dial print (waffle centre, minute track, logo, date).

case.note: one polished body: case, lugs and the crown-side flank from the traced head outline

bezel.note: smooth polished bezel: outer slope to a step at 18.24 mm, inner ring to the crystal (render rings)

dial.note: flat black dial: waffle centre, minute track, logo and the date window printed; black rehaut cone to the crystal

indices.note: applied polished kite indices (traced) and numerals 12, 9, 6 (traced with their holes)

hands.note: polished leaf-sword hour and minute hands with lume, polished seconds needle with a short counterweight

bracelet.note: five columns: polished outer and centre links (joints at 24.3 mm + 7 mm pitch), brushed middle links half a row nearer the case (21.8 mm); house curl from the first outer joint

steel_polished.note: house polished steel: bezel, crown, index frames, hands, bevels

steel_brushed.note: house brushed steel: case, lugs, crown guards

review.subtitle: Polished steel case, black waffle dial, applied indices and numerals, steel bracelet. Front relief GLB.
notes: Built on Hamilton's official 2000 px front render. House method: case, lugs, bezel, crown, applied indices, numerals 12, 9 and 6, hands and the bracelet are modelled; the photo is used only for the dial print (waffle centre, minute track, logo, date).
The dial print in the render is turned about 1 degree; the model is straight.
The bracelet curls under at both ends, like the other tracker watches. The clasp is left out.
